## Plan-cell decisions carried verbatim (implemented, never re-decided)

- `D-K7-2 [B-22] = the lane` — feeds are the release web build's surface; the lane never owns feed paths (P37.33's `lane_owns_object` contract untouched).
- `D-K7-5` — "every place, so subscribers can come early": a feed mints for every emitted place page including empty ones (Cleveland County, Germany, `unplaced`), verified by check-feeds coverage + the `deu.ics` e2e.
- K7 §5.5 feed rules — UID `<handle>@surveillancegraph.org`; `SEQUENCE` increments on the recorded move (`superseded`); `STATUS:CANCELLED` on withdrawn/superseded (no reason text, J3 §9.2); `DTSTAMP`/`lastBuildDate` = the watch build's `generated_at` (SIG-WATCH-006); all-day `DTSTART;VALUE=DATE`; `URL` = item page; `REFRESH-INTERVAL`/`X-PUBLISHED-TTL` P1D; empty calendar carries a UTC `VTIMEZONE`; RSS `pubDate` = `first_seen`, `ttl 1440`, `atom:link rel="self"`; nginx types `text/calendar`/`application/rss+xml`/`application/feed+json` scoped to the feed paths; `max-age=3600`.

## What landed

- `web/src/lib/watch-feeds.ts` — scopes, path minting, emitters (iCal/RSS/JSON Feed/OPML), `feedBuiltAt`, `feedUid`, `feedSequence`, `feedStatus`.
- `web/src/pages/watch/feeds/[...scope].{ics,xml,json}.ts` + `watch/feeds.opml.ts` — the static feed endpoints (141 files emitted in fixtures mode: 85 .ics, 27 .xml, 27 .json, 1 .opml).
- `web/src/pages/watch/feeds/index.astro` — the directory rewritten over the v2 set (all/place/kind/vendor/technology rows + OPML + how-to + legacy renewal feeds); `web/src/components/WatchFeedLinks.astro` — the format trio.
- `web/src/pages/watch/place/[...path].astro` — the subscribe trio per place; `web/src/pages/watch/item/[handle].astro` — "add to calendar" per-item `.ics` link.
- `web/src/lib/nav.ts` — the "Feeds" child restored (staged for this row).
- `ops/web/nginx.conf` — `text/calendar ics` + `text/x-opml opml` http-level; `location /watch/feeds/` feed types + `max-age=3600`; `location ~ ^/watch/[^/]+\.xml$` legacy `.xml` → `application/rss+xml` (K7 Q11 defect fixed).
- `web/scripts/check-feeds.mjs` — validation in `npm run check` (iCal/RSS/JSON Feed/OPML shape + per-place coverage + directory link crawl + T0 byte ceiling from `page-budgets.json`).
- `docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-23.md` (WF-01…04 pending) + `tests/unit/test_p37_34_copy_batch.py`; `tests/unit/test_p37_34_watch_feed_nginx.py`.
